idx_h2_who: You are the issuer. We are the infrastructure.
idx_who_lead: Built for an institution that issues and services a tokenised, asset-indexed obligation under its own licence. Gold is the first case carried through to the end — its contracts are deployed, verified and running. A different underlying asset gets its own set of contracts: the price source and the unit of measure are fixed at deployment on purpose and never change afterwards — the same property that stops anyone rewriting the rules retroactively.
idx_aud1_p: Deposits attracted against an asset-indexed return; a new retail product for a customer base you already have.
idx_aud2_p: A settlement instrument and wallet on top of the fiat rails you already operate.
idx_aud3_p: Contracts and an application ready to run under the regulatory base you already hold.
idx_h2_labor: What we build — what you bring
idx_we1_p: Issuance, burning, coverage ceiling, enforcement built into the contract
idx_we2_p: The key sits on the customer's device — you do not hold other people's funds
idx_we3_p: A finished customer path: obligation↔som swap, savings
idx_we4_p: The network rejects issuance above the ceiling you set
idx_you1_p: The regulator (NAPP) determines the type of licence
idx_you3_p: You set it yourself, at your own discretion
idx_you4_p: Instruments and treasury stay on your side
idx_econ1_p: Funds arrive for an asset-indexed return rather than an ordinary som deposit — a new reason to keep money with you.
idx_econ2_p: A swap fee on the obligation↔som exchange. The current contracts charge no fee — this is a monetisation model for the next version, not revenue we claim today.
idx_econ_note: Concrete rates, the spread against the local alternative and the fee points come in a separate write-up once there is a number that can be checked. We are not inventing them here. What exists today is kept separate from what is planned.
idx_risk_h2: The obligation is indexed to gold — the assets behind it are in som
idx_risk_p: The obligation is denominated against the price of gold while the covering capital is held in som. A rise in gold increases the obligation in som terms. This is structural market risk, and we say so plainly instead of hiding it.
idx_risk_note: We show the size of the exposure in real time. Managing that risk sits with the partner: the treasury, the licence and the hedging instruments are already yours. We provide the machinery and the transparency, not advice about your business.
idx_h2_proof: Coverage can be read at any second — without trusting us or the bank
idx_proof_lead: The coverage ceiling is published by a separate contract. Issuance above it is rejected by the network — not by the interface, and not by us. An attestation is valid for one hour: stop refreshing it and issuance halts on its own. Not a quarterly report, but two numbers on a chain.
idx_proof_cap: Snapshot of 2026-07-29 · on-chain these values can be read at any second; this is a fixed copy, the live figure always sits on the contract.

idx_open_code_p: Contract sources, tests and build settings are in a public repository, and the contracts are verified (the source matches the deployed bytecode byte for byte). Your engineer, or an automated assessor, reads them without us in the room. That is what replaces «take our word for it».

idx_status1_p: zkSync Era Sepolia. Tokens carry no monetary value — this is proof that it works, not a production issuance.

hiw_title: OltinPay — how it works (architecture, invariants, limits)
hiw_h1: What the code guarantees, not what the marketing says
hiw_lead: Every statement below names the contract and the function that enforces it. Not «solid architecture», but specific invariants that you — or an automated assessor — can check yourselves. The boundaries and the weak spots are named outright.
hiw_h2_arch: Where everything lives — and what never crosses the line
hiw_diagram_label: Diagram: three zones and the red line the key never crosses
hiw_node_key_p: derived from the seed, lives only here
hiw_node_index_p: reads chain events for the history feed
hiw_node_api_p: stores no key; from the wallet it has the address
hiw_arch_note: The server cannot sign on the customer's behalf and does not hold funds — it reads the chain and serves the interface. The authority to spend belongs to the key on the device, and to nothing else.
hiw_h2_inv: Checkable statements — with contract and function
hiw_inv_lead: The source of every contract is published and verified — it matches this repository byte for byte. Open the address that holds the funds and read the Solidity yourself: not «believe the code is like this», but «check it». Every invariant below is held by the network, not by the application — it cannot be bypassed through the interface, or through us.
hiw_inv1_h: Issuance cannot exceed the attested ceiling
hiw_inv1_p: Minting is rejected when totalSupply() + amount exceeds the attested reserve. The check lives in the token contract; the interface cannot route around it.
hiw_receipt_mint: A purchase that minted within the ceiling
hiw_inv2_h: A stale attestation halts issuance by itself
hiw_inv2_p: If the attestation is older than one hour (maxAgeReserve = 3600), minting reverts. Stop attesting and issuance freezes. It fails towards safety.
hiw_inv3_h: A deposit is locked for 7 days — nobody can shorten that
hiw_inv3_p: Each deposit creates a lot with lockedUntil = now + 7 days. Withdrawal draws only from unlocked lots. Neither an administrator nor anyone else takes it out earlier.
hiw_inv4_h: An administrator cannot touch someone else's deposit
hiw_inv4_p: Withdrawal works only on the lots of msg.sender — the restriction is welded into the function itself, not into application rules. An administrator has no path to a depositor's funds.
hiw_inv5_h: The customer's key never leaves the device
hiw_inv5_p: The wallet derives the key from the seed on the device and signs locally. The server stores no key and cannot sign; from the wallet it holds only the public address (account data such as a Telegram id is stored, but grants no access to funds).
hiw_h2_path: What happens on a purchase, a swap and a sale
hiw_path_label: Diagram: eight steps, each labelled with its action
hiw_step3_p: the exchange mints the token — but only within the attested ceiling
hiw_step4_h: Holds it in a non-custodial wallet
hiw_step4_p: the key belongs to the customer
hiw_step5_p: or stakes it for a return
hiw_step7_h: Receives som from the exchange treasury
hiw_h2_roles: Who can do what — and what nobody can do
hiw_role_publisher: Publisher — sets the coverage ceiling (in production, the partner)
hiw_role_exchange: Exchange — mints and burns the token, within the ceiling. The MINTER role is held by exactly one address — the exchange contract, not a human key (verifiable by replaying the RoleGranted/RoleRevoked events)
hiw_nobody_2: Withdraw someone else's deposit before its term
hiw_nobody_3: Sign for a customer, or extract their key
hiw_h2_stack: Every choice with a reason, not a logo
hiw_zksync_p: Transfers and swaps cost pennies. On an expensive network the micro-transactions of a retail product do not add up.
hiw_noncustodial_h: The issuer does not hold other people's funds
hiw_noncustodial_p: The key belongs to the customer — less operational and regulatory load on the partner, and no hot storage of other people's money.
hiw_noupgrade_h: The rules cannot be rewritten after the fact
hiw_noupgrade_p: The contracts are immutable — neither we nor anyone else can rewrite the logic under what has already been issued. The trade: a fix requires a new contract and a migration.
hiw_discipline_p: The review process is part of the product: the significant blockers — fund drainage, authentication bypass, a race on the reserve, double issuance — were caught by adversarial review. All of it reads directly in the repository.
hiw_limits_lead: A precise self-assessment is not weakness but a sign of maturity. A project with no weak spots reads as an advertisement.
hiw_limit1_p: zkSync Era Sepolia; tokens carry no monetary value — this is proof that it works, not a production issuance.
hiw_limit2_p: The internal adversarial review process is running; an independent audit comes before any production launch.
hiw_limit3_p: Deliberately — the rules cannot be rewritten after the fact. The price: a fix requires a new contract and the migration of live positions.
hiw_limit4_h: Administration sits on a single key.
hiw_limit4_p: Administrative roles are still on one EOA. Under a pause a user can do nothing (deposit, withdraw, claim), while the administrator can still withdraw the reward pool (withdrawRewardPool is not pausable). Principal and ceiling are untouched by this: nobody can seize a deposit or issue above the ceiling. Moving to a multisig is planned, and it takes priority over monetisation.
hiw_limit5_p: The history feed is built by reading events; on a chain reorganisation it may briefly lag — balances and on-chain invariants are unaffected.
lic_h1: The regulatory base is yours. The integration is ours.
lic_no_legal_advice: we do not give legal advice and do not stand in for the regulator.
lic_lead_tail: Below: the supervision this instrument operates under, and how your infrastructure connects to ours.
lic_h2_license: This activity is subject to mandatory licensing
lic_regulator_body: In Uzbekistan, crypto-asset activity is licensed by the National Agency of Perspective Projects (NAPP), and the service is provided by a licensed partner. The type of licence and its requirements are determined by the regulator. The register of service providers and the current requirements are published by the agency.
lic_no_advice: We do not publish an approximate reading of the licensing regime: on a page written for financial institutions, an error there would discredit everything else on it. The exact type and scope of licence are checked against the regulator's own source during the pilot.
lic_partner_2: Fiat rails — som in and out
lic_h2_phases: From pilot to production, in honest phases
lic_phase1_p: A working demonstration on zkSync Era Sepolia: contracts, wallet, exchange, staking. Scenarios, rail integration and KYC on the partner's side can be exercised — with no real funds involved.
lic_phase2_p: An external audit before any launch carrying real value. The internal adversarial review process already runs and is visible in the repository.
lic_phase3_p: Administrative roles move off a single key onto a multisig — this takes priority over any monetisation.
lic_phase4_h: Production issuance under the partner's licence
lic_phase4_p: Deployment to the production network, connection of fiat rails and of the issuer's covering capital, public launch.
lic_no_dates: We do not publish dates without grounds — they depend on the audit, on the partner's regulatory track and on the integration of its rails. They are discussed during the pilot.
lic_iface1_p: Som in and out connects to the exchange and the settlement path — on the partner's side. Accounting for fiat entering and leaving follows the partner's own procedures.
lic_iface2_p: Customer checks are built into entry to the application under the partner's rules. The wallet is non-custodial — the key stays with the customer.
lic_iface3_p: Administration, setting the coverage amount, confirmations, statements — the issuer's operator interface.
lic_iface4_p: Reading state (coverage, balances) and operations go straight to the contracts — readable and checkable by anyone, including the partner's auditor.
